svg.title: Two curves that cross three times: f(x) = x³ − 3x and g(x) = x
svg.desc: The cubic f(x) = x³ − 3x (crimson) and the line g(x) = x (blue) cross at (−2, −2), (0, 0) and (2, 2). Between x = −2 and 0 the cubic is on top (region shaded pink, with a vertical rectangle of height f − g); between 0 and 2 the line is on top (region shaded blue, rectangle of height g − f). A side panel adds the two pieces: the integral of x³ − 4x from −2 to 0 is 4 and the integral of 4x − x³ from 0 to 2 is 4, so the area is 8. A single integral of f − g from −2 to 2 is 0 because the pieces cancel: it gives a net amount, not the area.
svg.text: Area = ∫ from −2 to 0 of (f − g) dx
But ∫ from −2 to 2 of (f − g) dx = 0:
